## What is Abyssal Pet?

Abyssal Pet adds a powerful and mysterious void-themed companion to your world — the **Void Pet**.
This creature emerges from the depths of the void, fights alongside you, protects you from hostile mobs,
and even collects items from the ground to heal itself. It is not just a pet — it is a battle companion.

---

### Dungeon Loot
The egg can be found in chests throughout the world:

| Location             | Chance |
|----------------------|--------|
| Simple Dungeon       | 65%    |
| Abandoned Mineshaft  | 55%    |
| Ancient City         | 80%    |
| Stronghold Corridor  | 70%    |

---

## 🐾 Summoning Your Pet

Right-click the **Abyssal Egg** on any block to summon your Void Pet.
It will be tamed and bound to you immediately.
You can have up to **3 Void Pets** at a time.

---

## ⚔️ Combat Abilities

The Void Pet has **4 switchable combat abilities**. Cycle through them by right-clicking the pet with **Coal**.

| Ability | Description |
|---|---|
| **Void Strike** | AoE melee burst — damages and pushes all nearby enemies |
| **Shadow Pull** | Pulls all nearby enemies toward the pet and damages them |
| **Frost Breath** | Freezes and slows all nearby enemies |
| **Healing Pulse** | Heals the pet and its owner |

Abilities trigger automatically in combat every 2 seconds.

---

## 💪 Void Pet Stats

| Stat | Value |
|---|---|
| ❤ Health | 140 HP (70 hearts) |
| ⚔ Attack Damage | 6 |
| 🏃 Movement Speed | Fast |
| 🛡 Knockback Resistance | 40% |
| 👁 Follow Range | 32 blocks |

---

## 🧠 Behavior

- **Follows you** everywhere and teleports if too far away
- **Attacks hostile mobs** that target you or come near
- **Flees from Wardens** — it is not completely fearless
- **Collects nearby items** from the ground to heal itself when damaged
- **Passively regenerates** 1 HP every 5 seconds
- **Never despawns** — it is always persistent
- Does **not attack other Void Pets**

---

## 🍖 Healing Your Pet

Feed the pet **any item** to restore 4 HP.
The pet will consume the item and emit void particles as confirmation.

---
